recipe.visualDefinition: A cool-toned, minimalist composition featuring a male subject in urban winter attire against a desaturated, slightly blurred background. The layout uses a distinct white header for oversized, outlined typography and a vertical sidebar for secondary text, creating a structured, geometric feel.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject anchored to the right against a horizontal horizon line
Oversized display text overlapping the top white band and the image
Vertical secondary text aligned to the left margin
A soft, mint-colored circular graphic element in the bottom left corner
coreInvariants: Cool-toned, desaturated color palette (blues, greys, whites)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male subject positioned on the right third of the frame, looking away from the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The oversized outlined display text in the top white header.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the vertical text on the left down to the mint circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the top header and open, blurred space in the left background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and cool grey-blue tones in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy in the subject's beanie and sweater.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft mint green in the circular graphic element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white header and dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red, orange, or yellow
Keep saturation low except for the mint accent

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' features a long, straight descender that cuts into the image area
The 'r' and 'a' are stretched horizontally to emphasize the wide track
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between oversized, outlined horizontal display text and small, solid vertical subtitle text.
graphicDevices: Horizontal white band at the top
Soft-edged mint green circle in the lower left corner

preserve: Outline-only style for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric, wide-track skeleton for the display text.
Clean geometric sans for the vertical subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a black beanie, black sweater, and white puffer jacket standing against a blurred, cool-toned outdoor background with a visible horizon line. Leave the top 25% of the frame as a solid white band. Place a soft, semi-transparent mint green circle in the bottom left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in an ultra-wide, outlined lowercase sans-serif font across the top white band, allowing the descenders to overlap the image. Add the subtitle text vertically along the left side in a small, solid black sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the subtitle text rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise?
Is the color palette strictly cool-toned with a mint accent?
Does the top text overlap the image boundary?

adjustableVariables: Background location (as long as it remains cool-toned and blurred)
Specific color of the accent circle
mustRedesign: Do not use existing brand logos
Ensure the text content is original
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white header is perfectly horizontal.
Ensure the vertical text is legible and properly aligned to the left.
Verify the mint circle has a soft, feathered edge.
Confirm the display text is significantly wider than it is tall.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key white header with a cool-toned urban portrait, using ultra-wide outlined typography to bridge the two sections.
